Library Board
  MINUTES – July 26, 2023
The Inglewood Library Board met on July 26, 2023, via Zoom. Chairman Patt Sanders called the meeting
to order at 4:30 p.m.
Roll Call

Present:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy City Manager
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Management Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board member Cochran made a motion for the approval of the minutes for June 28th, 2023.
  Board Member Sanders seconded the motion.

  All in favor, motion passed.

Library Report

Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh gave the board members construction updates on Morningside Park
Library and renovation project updates on the Main Library. Mr. Singh stated that City Council is asking for
one large meeting on September 6, from 6 pm – 7:30 pm, instead of multiple small meetings, and a survey
will be out for the public and will remain open for a couple of weeks.

Board member Sanders asked for a survey copy.

Deputy City Manager Harjinder Singh told the board that the survey would be released to the public after the
Mayor and Council approval.
 Library Manager Kerri Arroyo provided the board members with the library update and presented pictures of
the outstanding programs throughout the Summer Reading Program, including Folkloric (Brazilian Dancers);
making Boba slime; ice cream making program; park pass checkout with backpack giveaway with lots of
goodies inside; outreach at Rogers Park; lunch at the library program with lots of activities; Jurassic Parties
with lots of reptiles; 1190 participants and lots of giveaways with 40 grand prize giveaways at the grand finale.
Library Manager Kerri Arroyo also gave an update on making a new library card design and a new tote bag
with the library logo to come soon.

Board member Sanders asked where people can get information regarding the events and programs.

Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that librarians appear at the schools and parks. The library has many
followers on Facebook and Instagram, and billboards and the Newsletter help keep everyone up to date with
everything in the library; new events: new programs, giveaways. The library also has a 12-second
advertisement showcased in every movie theater for every movie shown at the Cinepolis movie theater for
one year.

Friends Report

Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library,
couldn’t attend the meeting due to a family emergency, but they always get donations.

Board Member Sanders asked if she could leave donations at the library.

Board Member Douglas stated that there is a donation bin at the library.

Board Member Sanders asked about the new library card design.

Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that the design team is working on it.

Public Comments

Community member Gregory Mason prefers in-person meetings; public contact is better. He hopes that we
can meet in person for future meetings.

Board Member Comments

Board Member Douglas appreciates Kerri Arroyo for sharing lots of information, and she is amazed at how
many people attend the programs and events.

Board Member Cochran congratulates Kerri Arroyo on the theater promotion and recognizes the hard work
at the library. She asked if there was anything for pre-teens or teens and when groups come to the library if
they all have library cards or if staff promote them.

 Library Manager Kerri Arroyo states that the Teen librarian is focused on the Teen advisory board; when
there are adult and family programs, it brings the teens, which allows them to participate in all programs.
 And staff constantly interact with patrons. Everyone who comes to the library gets a library card. The goal is
for everyone to have a library card that enters the library.

Board Member Cochran met with her councilwoman and shared the issue of not having a full board. Her
councilwoman will work with other council members and address that.

Board Member Sanders asked Kerri Arroyo if anything else was planned for the library.

Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that there’s a National Night Out from 4 pm – 8 pm, which will include
lots of nice giveaways. Also, the library is already planning for the holidays.

Community member Gregory Mason stated that he is trying to contact Ernest Castillo and doing his best to
stay involved with the district and community.

Board Member Sanders told Gregory Mason that Ernesto Castillo is very busy and will contact him. And
appreciates librarians for their work.

With no further comments, the meeting adjourned at 5:25 pm.
